title: Reliquary clean-architecture rebuild task DAG

rules.target: 22 support crates plus reliquary-memory Root, ADR 0047
rules.no_compatibility: Do not add temporary bridges, copy the old owner aggregate or maintain dual semantics. Only isolated offline 2.0-to-2.1 DATA converter before activation.
rules.verification: Coherent final-destination target crates at G1-G4; complete rebuild and 2.1 corpus at G5-G6; original reference remains functional
rules.parallel: Separate stable reference worktree from rebuild worktree; parallel-ready tasks must not concurrently edit overlapping target owners
rules.external: External integrators must compile or be explicitly blocked, never silently waived
rules.cutover: Publish the new architecture only when whole rebuilt target, converted current corpus and consumers are validated

tickets.title: Freeze stable reference and initialize separate rebuild worktree
tickets.source_scope: main root, CLI, fixtures, installed host consumers
tickets.deliverable: Verified read-only reference state and isolated rebuild worktree; do not modify stable implementation
tickets.acceptance: Record baseline commit, snapshot working tree before any change, preserve unrelated Graph edit, ensure reference build remains usable; new target is created in a different worktree.

tickets.title: Pin semantic and performance baseline
tickets.deliverable: Pin semantic and performance baseline
tickets.acceptance: Capture exact command results, source IDs, selected retrieval rankings, per-domain history and latency/memory; distinguish unavailable external models.

tickets.title: Resolve FRS07 historical baseline in isolated reference validation
tickets.deliverable: Copy-based old-format evidence proof for authoritative FRS07 corpus
tickets.acceptance: In disposable reference validation only, prove authentic FRS07 replay and all receipts/clock states without modifying stable source/corpus; reproduce correction directly in new target.

tickets.title: Admit all six old-format canonical REL/PHY files
tickets.deliverable: Admit all six old-format canonical REL/PHY files
tickets.acceptance: Remove/resolve ignored six-file gate on copies; verify 3 REL+3 PHY owner UUIDs, full heads, exact SHA and no mutation.

tickets.source_scope: all current writer/reader codecs, inventory JSON
tickets.deliverable: Classify 173 CVA marker candidates and every dynamic magic
tickets.acceptance: Label current write/read, retired, invalid/test-only; record hash/offset/proof inputs, no unknown valid carrier; classify exact code path.

execution_model: Independent target-architecture rebuild from verified reference source; no in-place incremental refactor and no deliberately red migration window

phases.P0: Freeze and validate stable reference; isolate FRS07 fixture repair
phases.P2: Reuse semantic implementations inside final services and build named Application
phases.P3: Build final Gateway and operational journals without legacy Root
phases.P4: Finish clean public Root, CLI and final crate graph
phases.G4: Full synthetic 2.1 rebuilt-system gate (no old-format reader)
phases.P5: One-time DATA conversion and verified corpus activation, then delete converter
phases.G5: Full converted-data build and consumer gate
phases.G6: Measured parity and final architecture acceptance
